facts.raw_span: 10 days of right-sided chest and right upper abdominal pain and dyspnea
sharp, tearing, localized pain (7/10), worsened by movement and deep inspiration, without cough or hemoptysis
temperature 37.2°C

blood pressure 130/80 mmHg
respiratory rate 40 breaths/min
patchy, macular hyperpigmented rash on both shins and dorsum of the feet

white blood cell count 12.3 × 10^3/µL

pleural biopsy showed empyema without granulomas
